title: Binance P2P Adds Support for Cheems (1000CHEEMS) and Test (TST)  Trading Pairs in Selected Fiat Zones
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance P2P  has added support for  Cheems (1000CHEEMS) and Test (TST).  Trading for 1000CHEEMS and TST are now enabled against certain fiat currencies, which may include  CNY, VND, UAH, PKR, ARS, SAR, MXN, EUR, COP, USD and INR . Users can directly buy and sell 1000CHEEMS and TST trading pairs using various local payment methods on Binance P2P. Start Trading Now!
